drg.description: Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without MV >96 Hours with MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 56-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.45, creatinine 0.86, hemoglobin 13.4, platelets 199, sodium 141, wbc 6.2; vitals dbp 74-79, heart_rate 72-76, map 92-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 126-129, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.3
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Sepsis.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.84, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 207, sodium 141, wbc 6.5; vitals dbp 75-79, heart_rate 71-76, map 92-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 124-130, spo2 96-97, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Sepsis. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 56-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Sepsis. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
